answer: In an agent marketplace trading karst surveys and walnut crop forecasts, each identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding, with one active bid per bond. A public transaction thread lets buyers verify that each bid has its own locked collateral. Creating names is free, but running 1,000 bidding identities ties up $100,000 for a month, so an attacker cannot multiply bidding capacity without multiplying capital.
